description: Comprehensive Amazon RDS and Aurora operational review aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework and RDS/Aurora best practices. Use this skill when a user asks to review, audit, or assess RDS instances or Aurora clusters for best practices compliance, security posture, reliability, performance, cost optimization, backups, encryption, or operational readiness. Triggers on requests like "RDS review", "Aurora best practices audit", "database operational assessment", "review my RDS instance", "RDS health check", or "ORR for RDS".
